title: Disconnect to Connect: A Data Augmentation Method for Improving Topology Accuracy in Image Segmentation (CoLeTra)
mechanism: Augmentation that paints background-like patches over parts of thin structures and keeps the original label, so the model learns that structures that look broken are connected.
adaptation: Paste local background texture (same cell, same source) over 3 to 10 px stretches of crack and gridline labels, label unchanged. Aims at faint cracks (7% under 2% contrast) and E1 misses. No width bias because labels are untouched. Do not cover inactive regions or busbars.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + CoLeTra on crack and gridline, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, test crack component recall (>= 20 px), relP@2. Kill if E1 relF1@2 and component recall both gain < 0.02, or relP@2 falls > 0.02.
evidence: R (abstract): across architectures, losses and datasets, more accurate topology, often better Dice and HD, robust to its hyperparameters, works with topologically inaccurate labels.
prior_overlap: Crack copy-paste onto pool cells (n.d.) added cracks. CoLeTra removes image evidence under a kept label, a different mechanism. Open.
